sqlSourceCollectionName.description: The name of the SqlSourceCollection for which CDC is being configured

fileSourceSystemName.description: The name for the FileSourceSystem to create for staging (e.g. SqlSourceCollectionName + "_FileSourceSystem")

fileSourceCollectionName.description: The name for the FileSourceCollection to create for staging (e.g. SqlSourceCollectionName + "_FileSourceCollection")

transforms.description:
Array of Transform objects to be upserted for this source collection
These transforms define the data transformation from source to target
At this point, the transforms are not yet upserted. So, we define the transforms as json.

targets.description: Array of TypeMeta objects for target types to be upserted

title:
Configuration for setting up CDC (Change Data Capture) for a single SQL source collection.
This type encapsulates all the parameters needed to configure CDC staging and processing.
name: DataFusion.Ui.CDCConfig
